title: Move a layer from A to B, grow it, shrink it, fade it, Photoshop-style
goal: The user wants Photoshop blended into video: 'create text layers, animate them from place a to b, make transitions, grow/shrink elements'. Target: the user's mocks (docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, video-shell.html, comp-video.html and the page named here) at their fidelity; runner-prompt rules on default config, side-by-side with the mock, labels-not-explanations and right-click apply. Ask throughout: would a Premiere editor get this, and is it easier here?
notes: Filed from the 2026-09-23 video audit in the intake window.
acceptance: Press T over the video, type: the text is a layer on a titles track with an in and an out you drag

Move the playhead, drag or resize any layer on the canvas: with keyframing armed (a diamond on the track header, as Premiere's stopwatch) that makes a key; position, scale, rotation and opacity animate between keys
Keys show on the layer's track as diamonds you can drag, right-click for easing (Linear, Ease In, Ease Out, Ease In and Out) and delete
In and Out presets for titles (fade, slide, pop, scale) from the right-click menu
A walk makes a title fly in from the left, grow, and fade out, at Next defaults
